##Answer 1:
```{r}
for(i in levels(ChickWeight$Chick)){
ChickWeight$ChickWeightRange[ChickWeight$Chick==i]<- range(ChickWeight$weight[ChickWeight$Chick==i])[2]-range(ChickWeight$weight[ChickWeight$Chick==i])[1] 
}
```

##Answer 2:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_len))+geom_violin()+ theme_classic()+geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)+ scale_color_viridis(discrete=TRUE, option = "viridis")+facet_wrap(~species)
```

##Answer 3:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
data(starwars)
library(tidyverse)
starwars %>% summarize(meanMass= mean(mass), medianMass = median(Mass), modeMass = mfv(mass))
```
